sentences.text: Right, let's get going. Three things today: the September brief, the podcast backlog, and whatever's left of the site refresh.
Morning everyone. Sorry, my camera's being weird.
No worries. September brief first. Marcus, where did that land?
It's about eighty percent there. I still need the numbers from the June campaign to finish the performance section.
I have those in a sheet somewhere. I'll send Marcus the June campaign numbers on August 7th, that's when the finance export refreshes.
Perfect, that works. I can turn the brief around same week then.
Good. Now, the thing I keep coming back to is whether we should be doing long-form at all next quarter.
I've wondered that too. The engagement numbers on the long pieces have been flat since April.
Right. It might be worth restructuring the whole content calendar around short-form and seeing what happens.
Yeah, that makes sense to me. Big change though.
We should probably look at what the competitors are doing before we commit to anything that big.
Agreed, let's park it for now and revisit next quarter. Okay, podcast backlog. There are four episodes sitting unedited.
Four? I thought it was two.
It was two, then we recorded the founder series.
Someone needs to get through those before the end of the month or we'll be publishing stale content.
I'll take that one.
Thanks. Last thing, the site refresh. The copy for the pricing page still isn't done and it's blocking design.
How long has that been outstanding?
Three weeks. Chris, can you pick up the pricing page copy?
Which Chris?
Ha. Either of you, honestly, whoever gets to it first.
We'll sort it out between us. It'll be done by Friday, one way or another.
Oh, and somebody should refresh the brand style guide, it's a year out of date.
Great. Anything else? No? Let's wrap.
